articles.description: Should you continue your equity SIP when the stock market is falling? Remember, continuing an SIP does not guarantee returns. Equity investments carry market risk and are generally intended for investors with an appropriate long-term investment horizon. Investors should also review their mutual funds on their individual merits and invest according to their financial goals and risk profile. articles.title: Iran Fires Missiles, US Warships Targeted Amid Hormuz Alert? Mojtaba Issues Fresh Warning
articles.description: Iran is raising tensions around the Strait of Hormuz as conflicting reports emerge over fresh missile activity. Initial reports of a ballistic missile launch from the Bidganeh base were later disputed, with available accounts suggesting the missile may have been heading towards the test site instead. Separately, reports claim multiple anti-ship missiles were launched toward U.S. Navy or U.S.-escorted vessels, with explosions reportedly heard across the waterway. The claims and exact targets have not been independently confirmed. The developments come after an IRGC Navy official warned that Iranian forces could target U.S. vessels and destroyers as far as the Indian Ocean if another war breaks out.

articles.title: Iran Launches Missiles And Drones At Kurdish Groups In Iraqi Kurdistan
articles.description: Iranian forces reportedly launched ballistic missiles and Shahed-136-style drones at camps belonging to Iranian Kurdish opposition groups in Iraqi Kurdistan on September 27. Videos from the region showed explosions and thick smoke, while U.S. fighter jets reportedly intercepted some incoming threats. The attacks come just days before the United States is expected to complete its troop withdrawal from Iraq by September 30. Kurdistan Regional Government Prime Minister Masrour Barzani has warned that the region has faced more than 1,000 attacks since February. The latest strikes have renewed concerns over security in Iraqi Kurdistan as the U.S. military presence is reduced and Iranian missile and drone activity continues.

articles.title: China Says Ready To Implement Agreements Reached By Xi, Trump After US Visit
articles.description: China says it is ready to implement the agreements and key understandings reached between Xi Jinping and Donald Trump following the Chinese president’s three-day state visit to the United States. Beijing said the two leaders held detailed discussions on China-U.S. relations, global peace and development, and agreed on a framework based on respect, fairness and reciprocity. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said both sides also agreed to support each other in hosting major international events, including the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting and G20 Leaders’ Summit. Xi met Trump at the White House on September 23–25 before the two leaders toured the U.S. National Archives. Trump called the visit a success, while Xi said the talks added new substance to a constructive China-U.S. relationship.

articles.title: Iran Missile Hit Commercial Vessel Carrying U.S. Marines In Hormuz? Report
articles.description: A reported Iranian missile strike in the Strait of Hormuz has raised fresh questions about a previously undisclosed U.S. military mission. According to NBC News, an Iranian anti-ship cruise missile struck a commercial vessel carrying U.S. Marines on September 14, reportedly injuring eight troops. The vessel was not identified as a U.S. Navy warship, and its identity and mission details have not been publicly disclosed. The Pentagon also did not publicly acknowledge the reported incident. The account comes amid heightened tensions around the Strait of Hormuz, a vital global shipping route where Iran and the United States continue to maintain competing military interests. If confirmed, the reported strike could offer further insight into Iran’s evolving anti-ship missile capabilities and the risks faced by U.S. forces operating in the region.
